text:
ashley (partnerships): Quick thread to stitch together a Day-0 playbook for marketplace listings (AWS/GCP/Azure). Want a 1-page runbook we can hand to a PO. Key pieces: activation webhook, entitlement mapping, trial TTL, private-offer checklist, and creds rotation. Who takes which?
harper (cloud-eng): I can own activation webhook adapters (SNS, Pub/Sub, Event Grid). Will standardize payload to: offer_id, customer_id, entitlement_code, plan, start_ts, expires_ts, callback_url(optional). Will add HMAC header and idempotency_key.
noor (product): Product will own entitlement mapping + plan SKUs. Preference: single listing with plans (trial/standard/reserved). Default trial = 14 days, auto-conversion disabled. Entitlement_code format: redwood:{offer}:{plan}:{region}.
maria (legal): Legal: I'll draft short checkout text for telemetry opt-in (EU), and a private-offer addendum template. Need clarity on what billing metadata each cloud shares for private offers.
ben (solutions): From reseller/partner perspective: we need a provisional provisioning token flow and a conversion callback to handoff to SIs. I'll prototype a CLI: `rw mk-provision --org <org> --ttl 72h`.
marketplace-bot: MarketplaceBot: provisioning project created for playbook staging.
ashley (partnerships): Great. Action items recap: harper -> webhook adapters + example payloads; noor -> plan-to-SKU mapping + sample marketplace manifest; maria -> legal copy + addendum; ben -> reseller token CLI spec. Sync tomorrow 10am PT to pull into the single-page runbook. :calendar:
